items.title: Six wild elephants die in two months, raising conservation concerns
items.blurb: From Chitwan to eastern Nepal, a series of elephant deaths has alarmed conservationists, who warn that shrinking habitats, human activities and unsafe migration routes could threaten the country’s wild elephant…

items.title: Why drying Madhesh is a disaster in the making
items.blurb: Climate change is triggering multiple disasters simultaneously across the country, yet some remain far less visible than others.

items.title: Kathmandu to face Chitwan in NPL Eliminator after loss to Pokhara
items.blurb: Kathmandu finish third with a 55-run defeat, while Kushal Bhurtel misses a century by one run as Pokhara post a record 224.

items.title: Karnali sign off with consolation win as Chitwan finish fourth
items.blurb: The Rhinos, already through to the playoffs, end the league stage on seven points after falling 24 runs short of a 154-run target.

items.title: Bhattarai urges Prime Minister Shah to put five issues on agenda for India visit
items.blurb: In an interview with Kantipur, the former prime minister says Nepal should press India on the border dispute, trade deficit, air routes and hydropower, while seeking trilateral cooperation on the Himalayan climate…
